# Nagarjun Rajendran

## Blog

- [Silicon to Systems](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/): Nagarjun Rajendran on edge AI, cloud architecture, and the engineering behind systems that scale.
- [Agentic Architecture Arc, Part 1](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/p/before-you-build-the-ai-agents-the-eight-layer-production-stack): the eight layers a production agent system needs.

- [Agentic Architecture Arc, Part 4](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/p/what-ai-agents-keep-and-where-their-code-runs): memory, context, and runtime isolation for production agents.
- [Why LLM scaling does not work like microservice scaling](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/p/why-llm-scaling-doesn-t-work-like-microservice-scaling)
- [NVIDIA NVLink and the myth of the single GPU](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/p/nvidia-s-nvlink-and-the-myth-of-the-single-gpu)
- [The physics of memory](https://nagarjun.beehiiv.com/p/the-physics-of-memory-why-llms-are-memory-bound-and-not-compute-bound)

- [Building effective team cultures](https://nagarjunr.github.io/fieldnotes/team-cultures.html): Psychological safety, autonomy, and a personal Leadership Blueprint, in a 10-slide carousel.
- [Leadership is a relationship, not a title](https://nagarjunr.github.io/fieldnotes/leadership-not-a-title.html): What I learned about moving from doing the work to leading it, in a 10-slide carousel.
- [Eight GPUs were never eight times the machine](https://nagarjunr.github.io/fieldnotes/nvlink.html): Why interconnect bandwidth, not teraflops, caps GPU scaling.
- [Most people buy GPUs for TFLOPs. That is the wrong number to optimize](https://nagarjunr.github.io/fieldnotes/memory-bound.html): LLM inference is memory bound, not compute bound.
- [You can lead without managing people](https://nagarjunr.github.io/fieldnotes/lead-without-managing.html): Senior technical roles shape how systems are built, without direct reports.

## Context

Current formal role: Cloud and Technology Solutions Manager, Expert, Robert Bosch LLC. The e-scooter device figure is an architecture design capacity. Employer descriptions are limited to broad responsibilities and personal achievements.
